description: Exact time evolution via direct matrix exponentiation of the full Hamiltonian. Not a practical quantum algorithm — used as a classical reference for benchmarking approximate methods.
applicable_hamiltonians: Any Hamiltonian (limited by matrix size, not structure)
limitations: Exponential memory: requires storing the full 2^n x 2^n matrix
Not implementable on a quantum computer — classical simulation only

references.title: Nineteen dubious ways to compute the exponential of a matrix, twenty-five years later
